content.comment_body: I want to control the voltage of a 12V electromagnet using input from a displacement sensor, which provides a voltage depending on the displacement. The PLC reads this input and sends a corresponding output signal. If the sensor outputs high voltage, the input to the PLC increases, but I need the output voltage to decrease, and vice versa. Currently, it's working oppositely. I need a ladder diagram for this control scheme and also require PID or PD control for magnetic levitation of an iron bar. Please help. My project methodology is attached below for review.

Hello, To start, you need a device that converts the analog output of the PLC to a regulated power source for your magnet; you cannot connect the magnet directly to the PLC. Do you already have an amplifier for this purpose? You might find one at a hydraulic components shop. Once you have it, you can begin working on the program. Regards,

Based on your description, it may be better to use another PLC platform for this task. The current PLC might reach its limits quickly, and programming is more convenient using function blocks rather than ladder diagrams. I recommend considering a PLC with onboard analog inputs for better flexibility. Please consider this advice.

Thank you. I already have the necessary device. Now I require a program and want to first simulate it in software before implementing it practically. If possible, please share a ladder or function block diagram.

Story: "[user_name] was at my shop today and talked about the bread toaster he received from his uncle. He requested a freshly made loaf and a clean knife, specifically the raisin bread I make on Saturdays. He will call me later in the week to let me know if the bread is suitable for his toaster."

Hello, Are you asking someone to design your program? This seems like a school project that you need to submit for examination before the end of the year. Or are you presenting this as a business opportunity? What would be a fair fee in US Dollars, to be paid upfront?

Hi, Two points: 1) Since you're starting out with this PLC, I suggest using function block diagrams because ladder programming can pose challenges. 2) Try reviewing and using the available example programs, see how they work, and incorporate parts into your own project. If you encounter issues, attach your program here and we can offer assistance. Regards,

I have tried creating a program and can increase the output voltage with increasing input, but the reverse function isn't working. Please help. This is my final year engineering project, and I also need example programs for PD or PID control using the PLC.
Hello, Please zip your program and attach it here so we can review it and provide guidance on how to invert the output. Also, please mention which PLC model and version you are using. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users are working on a magnetic levitation control project using a PLC, facing technical limitations with hardware and control algorithms, particularly with analog output and PID/PD implementation. The conversation shows uncertainty about the PLC's suitability, programming types (ladder vs. function block), and how to manage inverse control logic and analog processing, indicating both knowledge gaps and a need for practical support resources.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the PLC to handle analog signals intuitively, support custom control logic including inversions, and provide integrated or easily accessible PID/PD options with clear sample programs or diagrams for guidance.
